answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 2069 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: With reference to the question #718 (Fatwa: 309=306/M), mentioned that old women can visit graves for gaining blessing and lesson.Lesson is ok but blessing I didnt get the point,can you please guide me.what does blessing means in this regard.Thanks Question: With reference to the question #718 (Fatwa: 309=306/M), mentioned that old women can visit graves for gaining blessing and lesson.Lesson is ok but blessing I didnt get the point,can you please guide me.what does blessing means in this regard.Thanks Answer ID: 2069 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 674/669=M) Blessing is tabarruk/barakah . It means to get and enjoy of the special mercy and blessings of Allah which he showers at graves of pious people. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
